description.value: Penticton IGA is a full-service neighbourhood supermarket on Government Street offering a broad range of grocery departments including a deli, bakery, and butcher counter. As a well-stocked IGA in the Okanagan, it serves as a reliable resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through Penticton. The store carries everything from fresh produce and packaged meat to household goods and personal care items.
